create.name: Zelda Hotaling
create.bio:
Zelda Hotaling grew up within Haudenosaunee culture, with family on the Kahnawake Mohawk territory near Montreal, and learned the ceremonial ways of her people first from her elders. She has made drums, rattles and other traditional instruments for close to thirty years, and from her home and studio in Castleton-on-Hudson, in New York's Hudson Valley, she works as an intuitive reader, drum maker and ceremonial guide.

Her best-known work is the Sacred Dream Circle Project, which began with a vision in 2012: a series of seven-foot hoops in the manner of dream catchers, woven from metals and thousands of crystals in sacred geometric patterns. People sit with the circles in guided meditation, often to the sound of crystal bowls, rattles and drums, and she has written a short book explaining the symbols in each one. She also leads day-long drum-making workshops, seasonal drumming circles around the solstices, house blessings with smudging herbs, and private sessions by phone or in person that can include intuitive reading, mediumship, ancestral clearing and throwing the bones. She has taken part in Kripalu's Amplify Voices of the Global Majority series and its Rewilding Summit, and keeps guest rooms at her home for visitors who come to sit with the circles.

courses.title: The Rewilding Summit
courses.description: A four-day gathering at Kripalu on reconnecting with the land, with storytelling, foraging, crafts and time outdoors led by several guides. Zelda opens the summit with Micah Mortali and leads a session on making rawhide offering pouches.

courses.title: Spirit-Guided Sessions
courses.description: Private sessions by phone or at her home in which she listens with Spirit to what is present for you. A session can include an intuitive reading, mediumship, ancestral clearing or a reading by throwing the bones, and is about choosing your own way forward rather than predicting it.

courses.title: One Day Drum Making Workshop
courses.description: A full day at her studio in which you build a 16-inch hand drum and beater from start to finish, choosing deer, elk or buffalo hide and painting your own rim. The making is held as a ceremony, and lunch and all materials are included.
courses.price: $400 USD (includes materials and lunch; $100 USD deposit)

courses.title: Create your own Sacred Dream Circle Workshop
courses.description: A five-hour class in which you weave your own eight-inch Sacred Dream Circle from metals and crystals, learning about sacred geometry as you go. All materials are provided.

courses.title: Sacred Dream Circles Meditation with Healing Sounds and Drumming
courses.description: A two-hour morning session at her home seated among nine of the Sacred Dream Circles. Rattles, crystal bowls and ocean drums are used to clear and settle the room before a closing drumming celebration.

courses.title: Sacred Circle – Sacred Symbols
courses.description: A drumming circle for the winter solstice with Molly Brindle at the Saratoga Spa State Park wellness centre, followed by making a house-blessing hanging from natural materials. Bring a drum if you have one; some are available to borrow.

courses.title: Guided Meditation (mp3)
courses.description: A downloadable guided meditation journeying through thirteen of the life-size Sacred Dream Circles, with a focus on compassion and love.

courses.title: The Sacred Dream Circle Project E-Book
courses.description: Her short e-book presenting the 21 seven-foot Sacred Dream Circles with a photograph of each and her reading of the symbols woven into them. A printed copy is also sold on her site for $10.

free_resources.title: Sacred Dream Circle Meditations
free_resources.description: A free set of more than twenty audio tracks on her site, one for each Sacred Dream Circle, mixing flute, drum and spoken guidance to listen to while sitting with the image of each circle.

flags: Her work is framed as healing ('Spirit Guided Healer', 'Spirit-Guided Healing Sessions'), but no medical condition is named anywhere I used; the session offering was retitled 'Spirit-Guided Sessions' and described without healing claims. Check this suits the page.

She presents a Haudenosaunee (Mohawk) family background and Indigenous ceremonial practice; the bio follows her own account. Her site spells the territory 'Kahnawaka'; the bio uses the usual spelling Kahnawake.
The Rewilding Summit is a Kripalu multi-presenter event; she leads the opening session with Micah Mortali and a craft session, not the whole programme.

Amplify Voices of the Global Majority (queue date 15 Dec 2026): the hub page says all sessions are already available as recordings on YouTube, so it was treated as past and left out as an offering; her session recording is included as a video.
'Create your own Sacred Dream Circle Workshop' is on the shared Workshops page (no page of its own), so that page URL is used; the drum workshop has its own product page.
The two dated home events (15 Nov, 13 Dec 2026) show no price on their pages, so 'Contact for pricing'.
Sacred Dream Circle Meditations page embeds SoundCloud tracks; I couldn't confirm all tracks play without an account.
Video 'One sided Drum Making workshop' is 2:02, at the lower length limit.
left_out: Amplify Voices of the Global Majority: recordings of a past free series.
The Rewilding Summit: The Livestream Experience: same summit as the in-person offering (kept the residential one).
House Blessings / Clearing ($200 plus travel) and Crystal Bowl Healing and Drum Circle: left out to keep offerings to teaching and ceremony; the latter carries 'healing' in its title (borderline).
Lodging (Tree House Suite and rooms) and shop items (drums, rattles, dreamcatchers, smudge supplies, cards, the Seed): products and accommodation, not teaching.
The Sacred Dream Circle Project printed book ($10): sold only on her site, not on Amazon, so not added as a book.

YouTube: Kripalu Amplify recording kept; 'James Introducing Zelda Hotaling and Documentary Preview' (someone else speaking) and a 39-second podcast trailer left out; two other uploads of 'Meet the Elder' (duplicates).
